_doc: 판테온 편 v3 원화 — v2 D4 기각("중간중간 지우의 이미지화풍이 너무달라서 확 깨") 반영. v2 시트 4장(build1·build2·build3·lime)을 같은 칸 구성으로 다시 그림. 지우 기준 그림 jiwoo_ref.png = v1 시트에서 지우 네 칸(dome 왼쪽 아래 얼굴·garage 왼쪽 아래·end 오른쪽 위·garage 오른쪽 아래)을 모은 한 장. 흰 곰 편 night.png 는 빼고(곱슬·애니 톤의 원인), 화풍 참조는 jiwoo_ref + v1 dome.png. 원본은 Drive 영상/20261122-curiosity-pick/art/<시트>_v3.png
common: Original illustration for an animated documentary film. Match EXACTLY the drawing style of the two attached reference images (jiwoo_ref and dome): the same warm clean painted editorial cel animation style, same line weight, same level of painted realism, same muted hand-painted palette: tidy readable silhouettes, natural anatomy, hand-painted muted palette, precise dark ink contours, subtle tactile brushwork, quiet cinematic lighting. No photographic realism, no geometric icon look. A perfect full-bleed 2x2 sheet of four distinct 16:9 film frames in one 16:9 image, equal rectangles, no gutters, no margins, no borders. Absolutely no text, letters, digits, logos, inscriptions or watermarks anywhere (any inscriptions on buildings are left blank). Keep the primary subject above the bottom subtitle safe area. Recurring invented character Ji-woo: Korean woman about 30, Ji-woo must be the SAME woman as in the attached jiwoo_ref character sheet (top-left close-up is her face): same oval face, same natural proportions and eye size, same straight shoulder-length black hair falling past the jaw with only slightly wavy ends and a loose side part, not curly, not fluffy, not voluminous; do not make her more cartoonish, cuter, or anime-like than the reference, wearing a mustard-yellow raincoat over a grey hoodie, dark jeans, white sneakers, a small crossbody bag; the same face and clothing in every frame she appears. In the imagined ancient Roman building-site frames she is a time-travelling visitor: same face and hair, same mustard-yellow raincoat over a grey hoodie, now with a wide leather tool belt and dusty sneakers, standing among ancient Roman workers in plain tunics. The building under construction is the round Pantheon rotunda in Rome around 120 AD: thick round brick-faced concrete drum, a hemispherical concrete dome built over curved wooden centering (formwork) and timber scaffolding. The Pantheon in Rome must look architecturally correct: porch with 16 granite columns and triangular pediment, round rotunda, interior hemispherical coffered dome with 5 rings of square recessed coffers and a round open oculus at the top, polychrome marble floor of circles and squares. Lighting: even if the scene is sunny, keep the same restrained muted colour grading and soft painted light as the reference sheets, not saturated or glossy.

sheets.build1: Top left: wide sunny ancient Roman building site, Ji-woo holding a long rope tied to a wooden stake in the middle of a huge flat cleared ground, walking in a giant circle and scratching its outline into the earth, Roman workers watching, the circle so large that four ancient ox carts parked end to end fit across it. Top right: the round brick-faced drum wall already standing, a huge curved wooden centering framework of the dome rising above it on timber scaffolding, workers carrying baskets on ramps, Ji-woo on the scaffolding pointing. Bottom left: on top of the wooden centering, workers pouring and tamping grey concrete in one even layer of the same thickness all around the curved formwork, Ji-woo with a trowel smoothing it, sun and dust. Bottom right: the plain uniform dome right after the wooden formwork is removed, long vertical cracks splitting open around the lower part of the dome near its base, bits of concrete dust falling, Ji-woo below looking up in alarm with hands on her head.
sheets.build2: Top left: close-up of the base of the dome being rebuilt very thick: a massive wall of concrete many times taller than a person, Ji-woo standing beside it looking tiny, measuring with an outstretched arm, workers laying another course. Top right: exterior view of the rising dome on the round drum, workers adding a series of stepped concrete rings around the outside of the lower dome like giant stairs pressing down on its base, Ji-woo on a ladder patting the step. Bottom left: three big wicker baskets of aggregate on the building site: heavy grey-white stone chunks, broken orange bricks, and very light porous grey pumice; Ji-woo dropping a pumice stone into a wooden bucket of water where it floats, smiling in surprise. Bottom right: a warm memory flashback: a small Korean child (young Ji-woo, about 6, bob haircut) on a living-room floor stacking colourful wooden toy blocks into a tall tower, placing a big heavy block on top and the tower wobbling, soft afternoon light.
sheets.build3: Top left: under the half-built dome, workers on scaffolding pressing square stepped wooden box molds into the wet concrete of the ceiling to make deep square recessed coffers in neat rings, Ji-woo helping push one mold. Top right: the nearly finished dome seen from inside, the top left open as a large round hole to the bright sky, Ji-woo standing on high scaffolding at the hole's rim looking up through it at clouds. Bottom left: the first rain falls through the round open hole onto the new floor, workers have laid a polychrome marble floor slightly raised in the middle with a few small round drain holes right below the opening, water running outward into the drains, Ji-woo crouching to watch the water disappear. Bottom right: years later, the finished Pantheon interior, fine long vertical hairline cracks visible on the lower part of the dome above the drum, the upper dome intact, Ji-woo with her palm on the wall looking up, calm and relieved, soft light from the oculus.
sheets.lime: Top left: at the Roman concrete mixing trough, a Roman worker in a tunic tossing pale white chunks of quicklime straight into the wet mortar, a puff of hot steam rising, Ji-woo leaning back surprised. Top right: macro close-up of the steaming freshly mixed grey Roman mortar with small unmixed bright white lumps scattered through it, volcanic ash and stone fragments. Bottom left: a modern construction site at dusk, Ji-woo in a white hard hat over her raincoat beside a tall wooden column form with a dense steel rebar cage inside, a concrete pump hose pouring fresh concrete into it. Bottom right: close-up of a modern concrete column surface in a damp underground garage, a thin crack with rainwater slowly seeping into it, a faint orange rust stain starting below it, cold fluorescent light, no people.
sheets.plan1: Explanation panels (v3, user 2026-11-22: show how it was designed, just enough to understand): in each frame Ji-woo explains with a large hand-drawn design sketch in charcoal and red chalk on a sheet of parchment or a whitewashed wooden drafting board on the ancient Roman building site; the sketch is a simple clear cross-section drawing with bold hand-drawn arrows and shading but NO letters, NO numbers, NO words, NO measurement figures. The sketch must be large and readable in the frame, occupying about half of each frame, upper or middle part. Top left: Ji-woo on the building site holds up a huge parchment sketch: the round Pantheon rotunda in cross-section (cylinder drum topped by a hemisphere) with a perfect circle drawn inside it touching the floor and the top, as if a giant ball fits exactly inside; beside the section a tall stack of small house outlines reaching the same height, Roman workers peering at it. Top right: on a whitewashed drafting board, a cross-section of a dome of the same thin even thickness everywhere; red chalk arrows press straight down on the top of the dome and at its lower edges red arrows push outward sideways like a skirt flaring; Ji-woo beside the board spreads both hands outward showing the flare. Bottom left: close-up of Ji-woo with charcoal pointing at the lower part of the same sketched dome where she has drawn several short vertical crack lines in red; in her other hand a small clay bar pulled apart into two pieces with a crack. Bottom right: Ji-woo next to a big board sketch of an improved dome cross-section: the lower part of the dome is drawn very thick and the outside has stepped rings like a staircase around the base; three small adult human figures stand stacked head to foot beside the thick base to show its thickness, Roman builder nodding.
sheets.plan2: Explanation panels (v3, user 2026-11-22: show how it was designed, just enough to understand): in each frame Ji-woo explains with a large hand-drawn design sketch in charcoal and red chalk on a sheet of parchment or a whitewashed wooden drafting board on the ancient Roman building site; the sketch is a simple clear cross-section drawing with bold hand-drawn arrows and shading but NO letters, NO numbers, NO words, NO measurement figures. The sketch must be large and readable in the frame, occupying about half of each frame, upper or middle part. Top left: Ji-woo traces with her finger a dome cross-section sketch whose wall tapers smoothly from very thick at the base to thin at the top, with two double-headed red measuring arrows (one long at the bottom, one short near the top) showing the thickness. Top right: a dome cross-section sketch coloured in three horizontal bands with chalk: dark grey heavy stone at the bottom, reddish brick in the middle, very pale porous light stone at the top; Ji-woo holds a pale porous pumice stone up next to the top band, and a small bowl of water on the table with a pumice stone floating. Bottom left: on a wooden table, two stacked tower models built from blocks: one stable tower with dark heavy blocks at the bottom and pale light blocks at the top, and one upside-down tower with heavy dark blocks on top that is tipping over; Ji-woo kneels watching the falling tower, smiling. Bottom right: a drafting-board sketch of the dome seen from below and in section showing rows of square recessed hollows (coffers) carved into the inside of the dome, the hollows shaded, small red arrows showing weight removed; Ji-woo shading the hollows with charcoal.
sheets.plan3: Explanation panels (v3, user 2026-11-22: show how it was designed, just enough to understand): in each frame Ji-woo explains with a large hand-drawn design sketch in charcoal and red chalk on a sheet of parchment or a whitewashed wooden drafting board on the ancient Roman building site; the sketch is a simple clear cross-section drawing with bold hand-drawn arrows and shading but NO letters, NO numbers, NO words, NO measurement figures. The sketch must be large and readable in the frame, occupying about half of each frame, upper or middle part. Top left: a sketch of a dome cross-section where the whole top is drawn heavy dark grey, with big red arrows pressing down hard on the top and the base drawn bulging and cracking; Ji-woo shakes her head and draws a big red cross-out stroke over the sketch. Top right: Ji-woo with a thin wire cuts the very top off a small clay model dome on a table, leaving a round opening at the top; behind her a sketch of the dome section with the top left open. Bottom left: a sketch of the domed building in section with rain drawn as lines falling through the round opening at the top onto a floor that is drawn slightly raised in the middle, with blue chalk arrows showing water flowing to small drain holes in the floor; Ji-woo pointing at a drain hole. Bottom right: Ji-woo stands between two pinned sketches comparing them: the left one is the first failed thin dome with red outward arrows and cracks at its base, the right one is the finished thick-based dome also showing a few vertical red cracks at the bottom only; she points from one to the other.
sheets.plan4: Explanation panels (v3, user 2026-11-22: show how it was designed, just enough to understand): in each frame Ji-woo explains with a large hand-drawn design sketch in charcoal and red chalk on a sheet of parchment or a whitewashed wooden drafting board on the ancient Roman building site; the sketch is a simple clear cross-section drawing with bold hand-drawn arrows and shading but NO letters, NO numbers, NO words, NO measurement figures. The sketch must be large and readable in the frame, occupying about half of each frame, upper or middle part. Top left: a sketch of the finished dome cross-section: short vertical red cracks drawn only in the lower part, the upper part drawn with many small charcoal arrows pointing inward toward each other along the curve (pieces pressing on each other), and the thick base with stepped rings drawn with inward hugging arrows; Ji-woo wraps her arms in a hugging gesture beside it. Top right: inside the finished Pantheon in soft light from the oculus, Ji-woo holds her sketchbook up toward the real coffered dome, the open sketchbook shows her final section drawing (thick base, thinning roof, open top) lined up against the real dome. Bottom left: a small three-layer clay model of the dome on a table cut in half to show its section: dark layer at the bottom, brick-red layer in the middle, pale porous layer at the top, open at the very top; Ji-woo's hands holding the two halves apart. Bottom right: Ji-woo pressing two clay bars: one bar squeezed between her palms stays whole, another pulled apart by her hands snaps with a crack; simple clear gesture, workers watching curiously.

_doc_plan: plan1~4: v2 D4 추가 지시("중간중간 인포그래픽 설명도 삽화로 … 어떤 느낌으로 설계했는지 보여주는 식 … 이해만 되면") — 검은 바탕 돔 단면 도식 박자를 지우가 그린 설계 스케치 삽화로. 화살표는 그림 안 손그림, 짧은 이름표만 위 띠 글로.
